messages.text: The first differential run passes 39 of 55 cases exactly. All 16 remaining mismatches fall into four bounded categories: keyword-led expressions were overclassified as commands, compact JSON had the wrong terminal newline type, cell paths were evaluated too early as ordinary expressions, and table/error formatting differed despite correct values/status. I’m addressing those as presentation and dispatch compatibility fixes; no new language abstraction is needed.
